items.title: Omer Simeon Interview, 1955-08-18
items.q: if you've played a trio like the ones you did with Jelly

ctx.x: There's one other question I might ask you, which is, sorry to put you on the spot too. Can you tell us anything about Jelly Roll? How do you like this style of playing?
Well, Jelly was very creative. And he came up during the ragtime era. So I guess you would call his style more towards the ragtime style, you know.
Was he easy to get along with, personally? Well, with us he was.
